svg.title: Seneca as a second voice
svg.desc: Five steps, from a search corpus of 2140 passages to 332 placed items and 83 clauses; a stacked column per article shows Backs (149), Adds (136) and Limits (47).
svg.text: How his passages were found and placed: 332 items in 38 articles, each one Backs,
2,140 passages of all 124 letters, in Gummere’s English, used only for finding
Ranked by closeness to each section; at least three logged searches by its key words
The letter around each quote is read; one sentence says what it is about
332 items: each Backs, Adds or Limits; 421 quotes from 94 letters
83: 36 add, 36 limit, 11 challenge; Marcus’s words are never rewritten

g.text: Figure 6 · How the Constitution was made
